articles.title: Monkeys Are Surprisingly Good at Shape Games
articles.summary: Scientists taught monkeys and kids to play shape-matching games. Guess what? Monkeys made the same kinds of mistakes as people. One baboon named Kalamata loves the games so much he plays for hours!

articles.title: This Summer Was the Hottest Ever Recorded in the U.S.
articles.summary: The summer of 2026 was the hottest in at least 132 years in the United States. Temperatures were 3 degrees Fahrenheit above average, and more than half the country was in drought by September.

articles.title: Physicists Can't Agree on How the Universe Works
articles.summary: A huge survey of physicists found they disagree on big questions like dark matter and black holes. Only two answers got majority support. One surprising finding: most say the Big Bang wasn't necessarily the beginning of time.
